properties.displayName: Audit public IP attachments to regular VM network interfaces
properties.description: Audits network interfaces with a public IP on any IP configuration, except explicitly approved appliance NICs. Application Gateway and Azure Firewall frontend IPs are not NIC resources and are unaffected. Audit is the default; Deny is available for a later approved rollout. Does not remove existing public IPs or cover VMSS instance public-IP configuration.

metadata.description: Start with Audit. Change to Deny only after appliance exceptions and application dependencies are reviewed.
Explicit resource IDs of NIC-based network appliances allowed to use public IPs. No resource tags or names automatically grant an exception.
